alternatives_and_negative_results: Do not reclassify the old attempt PASS, rerun its CPI, silently replace a sample, or merge denominators across campaigns.
applicability: Fixed-denominator qualification with software execution incidents.
assessed_root_cause: Execution validity and numerical acceptance are separate; a failed execution consumes its declared attempt and remains part of history.
author_role: historical project engineering record, backfilled by FPGA engineering copilot
chosen_corrective_method: Keep old ledger and input manifest immutable; create a new prelocked campaign with independent IDs/seeds and a separate one-shot runner/ledger.
generalizable_lesson: Use append-only campaigns and immutable attempt ledgers; a replacement must be an explicitly authorized new experiment, not a retry disguised as repair.
initial_faulty_assumption_or_design_deci: A repaired Runner could tempt an operator to overwrite the original campaign or retry the same CPI IDs/seeds.
non_applicability: Does not justify replacement campaigns without a new explicit engineer authorization.
observable_consequence: The first campaign remains 16/16 INCONCLUSIVE with one attempt each; the separately authorized C06R2 campaign uses new IDs/seeds and 8+8 prelocked denominators, each processed exactly once.
observed_problem: A common Runner defect caused the first 16-CPI campaign to fail all 16 executions before the numeric checks completed.
repeatable_validation: Verify old ledger hashes, new manifest, new ledger attempts=1, 16 unique seeds/IDs and final 8+8 disposition.
reviewer_role: documentary evidence validation by FPGA engineering copilot; not a separate human reviewer
safety_contract_constraints: Preserve C06R2 data and old campaign; no further C06 CPI execution is authorized by this experience record.
title: Preserve every CPI disposition and separate replacement campaigns by immutable identity
